column1: # sigeto redirect map: <old path><TAB><new path>, relative to content/.
# Maintained automatically from the renames git detects, and used to
# generate redirect pages at the old locations. Hand edits are kept;
# An optional '#moves' line says which of the renames git detects are
# recorded here, and so get a redirect page keeping their old url alive:
#   #moves off              none of them, while a site is being restructured
#   #moves since <commit>   only the renames made after <commit>
#   #moves all              every rename in the history (the default)
# The moves already listed below keep working whatever it says, and stale
# links in the markdown sources are repaired from every rename regardless.
